description: This file defines the EAPM class, representing external account provider configurations within SuiteCRM. It includes properties for API credentials, methods for retrieving login info, saving, deleting, and validating external account entries, as well as external API integration functions.

classes.name: EAPM
classes.description: Represents external account provider configuration including API credentials and login info. Extends Basic class and implements methods for managing external API account data.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Determines if the bean implements a given interface, notably 'ACL'.

methods.name: getLoginInfo
methods.description: Retrieves login information for a specified application, possibly from session cache, and decrypts the stored password.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a list query with optional owner restrictions based on user permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the EAPM record, filling in its name, handling passwords, and clearing cache upon save.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the record as deleted and clears cache.

methods.name: validated
methods.description: Marks the EAPM record as validated, deactivating other records with the same application.

methods.name: fillInName
methods.description: Fills in the name property based on the application and its API details.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields, including name.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates list view additional fields, including name.

methods.name: save_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up OAuth tokens and API data before saving.

methods.name: delete_user_accounts
methods.description: Deletes all external account records associated with a user ID.
